Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler

Class StartupPipelineOrchestrator

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler.StartupPipelineOrchestrator
@Component public class StartupPipelineOrchestrator extends Object
Sequences all post-harvest analysis pipelines to run in succession.

Called by FeedHarvestScheduler after startup harvest and after each daily harvest. Each pipeline is wrapped in try-catch so a single failure never aborts the remaining pipelines.

Pipeline execution order:

  1. Competitor page scraping
  2. HuggingFace model discovery
  3. Regulatory event harvest
  4. Clinical trial harvest
  5. Embedding (vector store)
  6. Framework competitive analysis
  7. Company discovery
  8. Sentiment analysis
  9. Trend detection
  10. Legal trend detection
  11. Research harvest
